decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program uses the firm's existing production and logistics know-how and gives delivery results that are easy to learn from, although it may be absorbed into the broader express line D.

The 72-hour program fits the firm's fast-response strategy and builds on established logistics, but its demanding operations and low visibility on the website keep the risk of consolidation relatively high.
The European-approved exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 fire-door system and draws directly on the firm's own R&D and certification expertise, making it a durable product.
This multi-model express line serves as the umbrella for the firm's fast-delivery offering and rests on core production and logistics competencies, so it remains a stable part of the range.
The digital ordering platform supports trade partners and generates usage data the firm can readily absorb and act on, which aligns with its service-oriented direction.
The fire and smoke protection door is a certified core competency backed by in-house engineering and is very likely to be kept long term.
